description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's data access from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including the datasource, schema, SQL, and photo binary storage.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver and update datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including migrating photo BLOB storage to bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with managed identity authentication.
